adjudications.finding: Frozen 力 kanji prose wrongly groups 力強い with examples where 力 itself voices. The frozen word card already distinguishes the components correctly.
adjudications.proposal: Preserve both examples: 底力（そこぢから）voices ちから→ぢから; 力強い（ちからづよい）leaves 力 as ちから and voices 強い つよい→づよい. Add the narrow observed component-attribution lesson to active scoped guidance.

会's 社 wrong choice becomes 公: 会 has an ordinary association/gathering sense, and Russian компания can denote a group as well as a firm. 公 is a visually plausible, clearly distinct public/official option. Retain the directed 社→会 edge: actual 会 label is встречаться; встреча, not общество/объединение. No automatic reverse edit.

Three direct guards: 書店–店 (bookshop is a shop); 水道–水 (actual adopted tap-water sense); 道–方 (actual 方 label includes способ and official 道/みち sense 6 explicitly includes means/method). Declare only on the new cards; no transitive closure.

No guard proposed merely from English energy/vigor or body phrases. The actual accepted 元気 answer is adjectival бодрый; здоровый, not noun энергия/силы. New 力 is сила; мощь. Reviewer must assess both quiz directions against complete bodies and ordinary senses; this is not an approval claim.

Teach usual local-public-body establishment/maintenance and normal 国立/公立/私立 distinction, but retain the named dictionary's qualifier: contrasting with 私立, broader 公立 can include 国立. Public ownership does not imply free entry, low price or universal access. Keep jlpt absent.

Preserve も.つ, -も.ち and も.てる with real uses. Distinguish modern potential from the prenominal possessed/available sense in 持てる力. The official kana-title entry supports popularity/usual kana writing, not a classical auxiliary derivation. Do not invent that derivation.

Separate named qualified history from modern visual mnemonics. Retain disputed/alternative accounts as such. Explain old 驛's 睪 versus modern source technical representative 尺 without claiming 尺 independently reads エキ. Do not turn modern 占/首 readings into historical Chinese sound proof.

Keep all source-selected rare readings and qualifiers. Extra dictionary readings, historical kun, names or metadata inclusion do not become grading additions or frequency claims. Selected 道 kunyomi remains exactly [みち]. Empty selected 特/駅 kun is not universal absence.

Preserve all four source word negative edges. 社会 title общество (социум) explicitly selects social society, not a commercial legal society/company; 会社 remains компания; фирма. The qualifier expresses the real source sense rather than redefining either word to dodge overlap.

駅 is ordinarily a railway/metro station. Explain ordinary bus stop バス停 without an absolute ban on all bus facilities called 駅. Preserve 駅前's mixed on+kun reading explanation and stable kango technical type.

limits: No historical-pixel inspection, frequency corpus, native certification, phone/IME/playback/newmedia/package authority or activation/release approval.
